sentences.en: They are using a telescope to look at the sky.
sentences.zh: 他们正在使用望远镜观察天空。

sentences.en: We can see things in the distance using a telescope.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用望远镜看到远处的东西。

sentences.en: The new telescope was shipped in a huge wooden box.
sentences.zh: 新买的望远镜是装在一个大木箱里的。

senses.zh: (使某物)变短(叠缩在一起) - (使某物)叠缩, 嵌入 -
压缩某物使其少占空间或时间

mnemonic: 词根记忆：tele（远）+scop（看）+e→看到远处→望远镜
